Guidance & outlook: Our revenue for Q1 FY27 grew at 9.9% on a year-on-year basis to INR 513.9 crores.
Our Q1 FY27 revenue stood at INR 513.9 crores, reflecting growth of 9.9% year-on-year.

So, like in Q1, we did around 43% growth Y-o-Y and you're giving a single-digit growth guidance for the whole year seems a little inconsistent, which is because of some seasonality where H1 is more dominating than H2.
Growth & demand: Our EBITDA stood at INR 101.1 crores, a growth of 33.1% year-on-year.
Our EBIT stood at INR 78.4 crores, a growth of 39% year-on-year.
What we are highlighting is the revenue growth which is Y-o-Y growth of 9.9%, which you see right now, INR 513.9 crores is what we did.
Margins & costs: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 101.1 crores, representing a 31.1% year-on-year increase, while our EBITDA margins improved by 343 basis points to 19.7%.
Our EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 19.7%, reflecting an expansion of 343 basis points year-on-year.
Our EBIT margin for the quarter was 15.3%, reflecting an expansion of 319 basis points year-on-year.
Capex & expansion: We will keep it at approximately the same level because right now, there's a lot happening in that space, and we need to keep abreast with what's happening with latest technology, plus we are investing in the platform that we are building.
And then, of course, there will be some degree of bolt-on acquisitions as well.
Balance sheet & cash: Our net cash and investments (net of debt) stood at INR 710.2 crores.
Risks & challenges: These risks and uncertainties are included but not limited to what we have mentioned in the prospectus filed with SEBI and subsequent annual reports, which you can find on our website.
There is still a degree of softness in the market because of the war and the uncertainties.
Right now, there's some degree of softness because of this uncertainty of the war.
